knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $A$ given below. Describe it in terms of $a_{ij}$.

$A = \begin{bmatrix}\boxed{1} & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 7 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}$
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $1$st row and $1$st column. Hence, we have $a_{11}=1.$
